purpose: Test whether an uncertainty-aware hierarchical log-rate state-space estimator improves the frozen QFE V2 dynamic count-state representation before any calibration, market comparison, or protected evaluation.

challenger_architecture.state_space: Gaussian log-intensity assumed-density filter with Poisson likelihood and Laplace posterior update
challenger_architecture.global_state: absolute log-rate, mean reverting to target initial home/away log-rate
challenger_architecture.competition_state: log-rate residual relative to the pre-match global environment
challenger_architecture.team_global_state: cross-competition log-strength residual measured relative to the pre-match competition environment, never normalized to the universal global rate
challenger_architecture.team_comp_state: local competition-specific residual measured relative to pre-match competition plus team-global effect
challenger_architecture.same_kickoff_contract: all forecasts and prior states frozen before any same-kickoff outcome update; node likelihoods aggregated within batch
challenger_architecture.uncertainty: posterior log-state variance propagated approximately into latent log-intensity variance and expected-rate intervals

evaluation.selection_rule: Within each target choose the candidate with lowest pooled DEVELOPMENT primary metric only if it also wins primary metric in at least 3 of 4 chronological folds and does not worsen pooled fixed-line binary log loss by more than 0.001 versus reference. Otherwise no Stage1 candidate advances.
evaluation.ties: If pooled primary metrics differ by <= 0.0005, choose lower-complexity order CONSERVATIVE < BALANCED < RESPONSIVE.

next_stage: A Stage1 advancing profile must receive a separate frozen V2.1 Stage2 protocol before any CALIBRATION outcome is read. Stage2 may test distributional integration of latent uncertainty and calibration, but cannot reuse V2 PROTECTED outcomes for design.
